model.name: Krea 2 Image Edit
model.description: One source, up to four labeled references, two optional LoRAs, compatible checkpoint switching and Qwen 3.8 27B BF16 enhancement.
model.hardware_note: Planning target, not a measured minimum. Qwen 3.8 27B BF16 uses about 56 GB of disk and unloads before Krea generation. Both Raw and Turbo BF16 are included. Extra references use a sheet within the upstream two-image editor, not independent native N-image conditioning.

task.title: Image edit with multiple references, LoRAs and Qwen enhancement
task.description: One source plus 0-4 optional, role-labeled references. Raw/Turbo BF16, two extra LoRAs and Qwen 3.8 27B BF16 ON by default. Two or more references are combined into a visible reference sheet. Two variants: Identity Edit and standard native Krea without Identity Edit LoRA (prompt-guided generation only).

variants.label: Krea Edit HQ - multi-reference
variants.source: Workbench integration of Krea2 Identity Edit v1.2

variants.label: Krea Standard - No Identity Edit LoRA (prompt-guided generation)
variants.source: Native Krea text conditioning, no Identity Edit adapter
